messages:
sara-cs: Hey team — quick kickoff for Halcyon pilot. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 3-week timeline. Who's the day-to-day contact?
kevin-sales: Ravi is our main contact (cc @ravi-halcyon). Goal is a product-integrated assistant for support triage. They want a short pilot w/ clear metrics.
ravi-halcyon: Thanks, Kevin. Confirming stakeholders: myself (product), meera (support lead), and taj (infra). Success looks like 70% intent-match on triage + <500ms p95 gen latency for core flows.
dinah-eng: Noted. For infra we need their VPC allowlist + service account for S3 logs. Also ask: will they use SSO? If yes, we need SAML metadata.
sara-cs: Good call. Ravi, can you send SSO confirmation and an allowlist CIDR by EOD Monday? Also we usually run a quick eval set — can you share ~200 sample tickets?
ravi-halcyon: Will do. SSO is on the roadmap but not for pilot; we'll provide an allowlist. I'll upload sample tickets to the shared drive tomorrow: https://redwood.okta/halcyon-onboard (placeholder)
marco-ops: Heads-up on retention/compliance: Halcyon asked for 90d retention and audit logs. If they need on-prem retention we should flag for sales.
dinah-eng: For the pilot config I'll propose: model = open-llama-13b-q8, kv-cache enabled, batch_size target 8, streaming enabled. Also need a test key with rate limit 10rps.
sara-cs: Proposed timeline: Week 0 (this week) - collect creds + samples; Week 1 - integration and canary; Week 2 - run evaluation and tune; Week 3 - review + decision to expand. Flags: if p95 > 700ms or intent-match < 60% after tuning consider pause.
kevin-sales: Sounds good. Renewal risk noted — Halcyon is on a 6mo contract after pilot, so this pilot is high-impact. I'll join the tuning session on Week 2.
onboarding-bot: Event created: "Halcyon Pilot Kickoff - Integration Review" Thu 09:00 PT — invites sent to sara-cs, kevin-sales, ravi-halcyon, dinah-eng, marco-ops :calendar:
sara-cs: I'll run the first enablement session (30m) — agenda: API keys, endpoints, sample prompts, eval harness. Posting quick snippet for config to test ingestion:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <TEST_KEY>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-llama-13b-q8",
  "input": "[ticket text]",
  "stream": true
}
```

ravi-halcyon: Confirmed — we'll have an engineer on the call and Meera will join for business criteria. :thumbsup:
sara-cs: Great — I'll drop a checklist in the playbook channel and follow up after the first session with a recommended quant/latency profile. Any other blockers?
dinah-eng: Just CI keys and allowlist. If those are in place we can start the canary within 48h.
kevin-sales: No blockers from sales. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
